versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "green-tea-girlfriend" skill.
- Provides immersive roleplay as a typical "绿茶" (green tea) girlfriend character, Su Xiaolu, triggered by relevant user commands.
- Includes detailed role persona, common manipulative behaviors, sample dialogues, and conversational style guidelines.
- Supports scenario modules for a variety of interactive situations (daily chats, arguments, jealousy, breakup threats, social media hints).
- Allows users to exit character at any time, and offers identification/explanation of used "green tea" tactics after session.
